purpose: Human-reviewed starting references for the first editable component families; source positions are one-based, not footer numbers.

references.title: Metric card
references.use_when: A single KPI with a short explanation.
references.visual_structure: A pale card with the value above its label.
references.recommendation: Recommended first implementation: independent background and two text fields.

references.title: Metric with context
references.use_when: A KPI that needs a sentence of evidence or qualification.
references.visual_structure: Wide panel; metric and label at left, explanation at right.
references.recommendation: Use when the number alone would be ambiguous.

references.title: Metric strip cell
references.use_when: Several comparable statistics in a common band.
references.visual_structure: Centered value and caption; white text on a shared navy strip.
references.recommendation: The navy band, dividers, heading and source note are outside this component.

references.title: Numbered key-point panel
references.visual_structure: Tall pale card; navy header with large magenta number; three text paragraphs below.
references.content_density: Medium; title and three supporting points
references.recommendation: First contract fixture. The new contract explicitly adds the visible number as an editable slot.

references.title: Numbered explanation row
references.use_when: Steps, reasons, or workstreams with a short explanation.
references.visual_structure: Horizontal pale card; thin side rule; separate number, title and body.
references.recommendation: Recommended general-purpose visual alternative; side-rule color should follow deck meaning.

references.title: Evidence and measurement row
references.use_when: A claim paired with supporting evidence and a measure of success.
references.visual_structure: Solid number tab; heading, evidence line and separate blue measure.
references.recommendation: Choose for claim/evidence/measure narratives, not when those fields are absent.

references.title: Decision option card
references.visual_structure: Top rule; small number, prominent title and subtitle.
references.recommendation: Source siblings use different rule colors; those are style options within this structure.

references.title: Evidence gate card
references.use_when: Readiness criteria, required evidence, exit state and decision owner.
references.visual_structure: Narrow outlined card with an inset pale exit section and ownership row.
references.recommendation: Specialized proposal variant. Narrow columns require particularly careful fit review.

references.title: Delivery pod: two roles
references.use_when: A lead and one delivery role.
references.visual_structure: Pale container/title plus two stacked navy role boxes.
references.recommendation: First pod fixture. Preserve staffing colors; connectors and legend belong to the slide.

references.title: Delivery pod: three roles
references.use_when: A lead and two delivery roles.
references.visual_structure: Taller pale container/title plus three stacked navy role boxes.
references.recommendation: First pod fixture. The shared Phase 2 backdrop is outside this component. The neighboring Data Engineer pod is a content example of this same structure.
